CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_TASK_END] @task_name [varchar](30),@pipeline_runid [VARCHAR](36),@data_layer [nvarchar](150),@status [VARCHAR](30) AS
BEGIN

	---END WORKFLOW
	UPDATE [OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] 
	SET 
		STATUS_ID = (SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = UPPER(@status)), 
		END_DATETIME = CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) 
	WHERE 
		PIPELINE_RUNID = @pipeline_runid AND
		TASK_RUN_ID = CONCAT(@pipeline_runid,'_',UPPER(@task_name)) AND
		DATA_LAYER = @data_layer; 

END
GO
